note: Lifecycle metadata about the frozen specifications. A frozen spec file cannot carry its own status: editing one changes its digest, which is the entire point of freezing it. This registry is therefore separate and deliberately mutable, and it records only what is true about a specification from the outside — where it runs and whether it is still running.

specs.name: published_library_net_positive_v1
specs.note: Factors as names into a vendored library, so the spec is not reproducible without it and is not published here.

specs.name: published_library_net_positive_v2
specs.note: The same four factors as portable DSL. Runs alongside v1 rather than replacing it, because re-expressing the factors changes the digest.

specs.name: single_name_rotation_v3
specs.note: Named a universe rule without naming where the universe came from. Two faithful implementations disagreed on 614 of ~4,700 eligible names while agreeing on the pick. Retired with the single pick it published rather than edited; the backtested span of the chart was computed under it.
